lawrence-summers.total: In the World Bank's fiscal years 1991 and 1992 (July 1990 to June 1992), the two full fiscal years in which the Bank's own officer lists name him Vice President, Development Economics and Chief Economist, its executive directors approved 451 lending operations: 229 in fiscal 1991 (126 IBRD loans, 103 IDA credits) and 222 in fiscal 1992 (112 IBRD loans, 110 IDA credits). Chief economist is a research post with no lending authority, so this is the scale of the institution he advised, not of anything he approved. Supplements are included in the amounts but not counted as separate operations, joint IBRD/IDA operations are counted once, and IFC, MIGA, GEF, Montreal Protocol, guarantees, trust-fund activities and debt-reduction operations are excluded. The part of fiscal 1993 he served is not counted (this map's sum of the Bank's 1991 and 1992 annual reports, Table 7-1).

joseph-stiglitz.total: In the World Bank's fiscal years 1998 and 1999 (July 1997 to June 1999), the two full fiscal years in which the Bank's own officer lists name him Senior Vice President, Development Economics, and Chief Economist, its executive directors approved 505 lending operations: 229 in fiscal 1998 (105 IBRD loans, 124 IDA credits) and 276 in fiscal 1999 (131 IBRD loans, 145 IDA credits). Chief economist is a research post with no lending authority, so this is the scale of the institution he advised, not of anything he approved. Supplements are included in the amounts but not counted as separate operations, joint IBRD/IDA operations are counted once, and IFC, MIGA, GEF, Montreal Protocol, guarantees, recipient-executed trust-fund activities, carbon offset, special financing and debt-reduction operations are excluded. Parts of fiscal 1997 and fiscal 2000 that he served are not counted (this map's sum of the Bank's 1998 and 1999 annual reports, Appendix 14).

riah-phiyega.total: As South Africa's National Commissioner of Police, she headed a service with a total personnel strength of 197,946 — 155,531 SAPS Act and 42,415 Public Service Act personnel — working from 1,132 police stations as at 31 March 2013, the end of Marikana's financial year and her first year in the post. She commanded a police service rather than overseeing projects, so the figure is the size of the force she headed (South African Police Service Annual Report 2012/13).
